name: sourceAFRICA
tagline: Africa's premier repository for actionable documents
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
funding_model: organisational support from Code for Africa
known_funders: ANCIR (African Network of Centers for Investigative Reporting)
last_funding_event: 2024-ongoing institutional support from Code for Africa
dependency_risks: dependent on Code for Africa / ANCIR institutional funding
awards: Recognition as key African civic tech infrastructure
outcome_methodology: observational - tracked through contributing organisation reports and published investigations
documented_limitations: automated document text may contain errors
governance_model: operated by ANCIR under incubation by Code for Africa; CC BY-SA 4.0 content licence
curation_criteria: actionable documents needed by the public or civic watchdogs; suppressed or censored documents
ai_involvement: minimal - uses DocumentCloud's OCR and text extraction capabilities
political_relevance_summary: sourceAFRICA addresses civic technology. Africa's premier repository for actionable documents.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides data, research, or educational resources for civic engagement.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication; currently focused on pan-African (47 contributing organisations); replication materials are available; would require local data and regulatory adaptation.
